statements.action_statement: No fixed release is available yet; update when Docker Hardened Images publishes one.
statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-84786 ('Possible NULL Dereference in Non-SMTP DANE Clients', Low): a DANE-enabled TLS client that accepts PKIX-TA(0) or PKIX-EE(1) TLSA records alongside DANE-TA(2) can dereference a NULL pointer and crash when a server presents a trusted CA certificate as its end-entity certificate with an unusual mix of TLSA records. DANE SMTP clients and DANE validation of raw public keys are not affected. OpenSSL's advisory (https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20261124.txt) lists OpenSSL 3.5 before 3.5.10 as affected and places the DANE API outside the FIPS module boundary. The fix for the 3.5 branch is https://github.com/openssl/openssl/commit/1ad851363d5b8588b0d40edcc045fd633e93f0c2 ('Fixes CVE-2026-84786'), which changes check_dane_pkeys() in crypto/x509/x509_vfy.c; OpenSSL 3.5.10, the first 3.5 release to carry it, is scheduled for 1 December 2026, and the newest OpenSSL release on 28 November 2026 did not include it. Debian lists trixie (3.5.9-1~deb13u1) and trixie-security (3.5.7-1~deb13u3) as vulnerable and has postponed the fix to a future update (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-84786). No published DHI Debian 13 openssl build carries the fix. Checked on 2026-11-28 against the live index of the DHI Debian repository: it publishes 18 openssl builds (every rebuild of Debian 3.5.5-1~deb13u2, 3.5.6-1~deb13u1, 3.5.6-1~deb13u2, 3.5.7-1~deb13u2, 3.5.7-1~deb13u3 and 3.5.9-1~deb13u1) for amd64 and arm64, each with libssl3t64, libssl-dev, libssl-doc, openssl, openssl-provider-legacy and their debug-symbol packages. In the libssl3t64 package of all 36 of those builds (each checked against the index SHA-256), libcrypto.so.3 carries the version string of OpenSSL 3.5.5, 3.5.6, 3.5.7 or 3.5.9, and the shipped changelog has no entry for this CVE, while the same changelogs record the OpenSSL fixes these builds do carry, for example CVE-2026-54872 from the rebuilds of Debian 3.5.7-1~deb13u3 on and CVE-2026-84785 in the newest build. Builds published only in the authenticated DHI security repository could not be read for this review; with no fixed version in the range, every build of this owner, including those, reads as affected. Every build is affected, so the range starts at 0 and has no fixed version yet; it will be reassessed once a build with OpenSSL 3.5.10 or a backport of the fix publishes.
